Customer-Centric Features 16 features

Recently Viewed History

Personalized "Continue Browsing" strip on Home & Product pages. Stores last 20 items.

Persistent Shopping Cart

Cart items saved to Database on login. Guest cart automatically merges with User cart.

Abandoned Cart Recovery

Automated email reminders sent to users who leave items in cart without checkout.

Smart Search & Filtering

Instant predictive search and deep filters (Price, Brand, Specs) for finding products fast.

Mobile-First UX

Touch-optimized interface with bottom sheets, swipe carousels, and thumb-friendly navigation.

Product Comparison Tool

Side-by-side specification comparison for up to 4 products to help users decide faster.

Wishlist & Favorites

Save products for later with a single click. Synced across devices for logged-in users.

Quick Cart Actions

Add to cart directly from listing pages with instant stock validation.

Related Products

Intelligent suggestions based on matching categories and technical specifications.

Spin the Wheel

Interactive gamification campaigns. Users win coupons, discounts, and prizes.

Delivery Estimator

Real-time delivery date estimation based on pincode and product availability.

Store Locator

Find nearby physical stores with map integration, directions, and store hours.

Bank Offers Marquee

Scrolling banner showing active bank offers and payment discounts on product pages.

Invoice Download

Download PDF invoices for completed orders from the user dashboard.

Order Tracking

Real-time order status updates with delivery tracking and notifications.

Address Management

Save, edit, and delete multiple delivery addresses with default selection.

Security + Summary
05 - Security & Infrastructure + 06 - Static Pages

Security & Infrastructure 8 layers

Role-Based Access Control

Admin, Super Admin, Vendor, Employee roles with granular page-level permissions.

Session Management

HMAC-SHA256 signed session tokens with 24h expiry. Edge & Node runtime support.

Rate Limiting

In-memory sliding window rate limiter for API endpoints. Redis-ready for production.

Security Headers

CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy configured.

Data Encryption

AES encryption for sensitive data like API keys and partner secrets.

Bot Detection

Automated bot detection and prevention for form submissions and API calls.

Cron Jobs

Scheduled tasks for abandoned cart recovery, spin wheel notifications, and cleanup.

Performance Monitoring

Web Vitals tracking, API response logging, and error monitoring.
